enter(uint256).details: Shares always round down so rounding dust benefits existing LPs.

exit(uint256).details: Deliberately NOT halted-gated — depositors must always be able to      exit. Halting only prevents new deposits and operator trading.

positionTotals().details: Reads live ids from each pool (never cached) and uses capped      staticcalls so a dead pool cannot brick the vault.

redeem(uint256,uint256).details: Applies profit-split on the collateral received:      80% → vault (distributed pro-rata on next exit)      15% → operator fees       5% → protocol treasury

MAX_POOLS().notice: Maximum number of pools the operator may track.

burnSet(address,uint256).notice: Burn matched pairs back to collateral.

exit(uint256).notice: Burn shares, receive collateral. Only from idle balance.

exposureLimit().notice: Max imbalance the operator may accumulate (raw collateral units).

mintSet(address,uint256).notice: Mint a complete YES+NO set into the vault.

nav().notice: Net asset value in raw collateral units. NAV = idle collateral + matched position value. Matched pairs are always worth par (YES + NO = 1 collateral regardless of outcome). The unmatched residual is valued at zero — the most conservative mark, ensuring NAV is a strict floor.

positionTotals().notice: Walk the roster and sum YES and NO balances across all pools.

redeem(uint256,uint256).notice: Redeem a settled position. Permissionless — anyone may call.

redeemFinalize(address,uint256,uint256).notice: Finalize + redeem in one tx if the market is not yet settled.

rosterLength().notice: Number of pools in the active roster.

trade(address,uint8,uint256,uint256,uint.notice: Place an IOC order on an approved pool.
